ask_bad_then_s.output:
Do you have access to Scopus? [y/n/not sure]: maybe
Error: please answer y, n or not sure
Do you have access to Scopus? [y/n/not sure]: s
Created project 'demo' at <root>/demo
Sources mode: openalex (recorded by Ada; change it with `prismabib sources`)
Mode openalex was recorded: this tool cannot assume you have Scopus access.
To check a Scopus key later, run `prismabib credentials set scopus` and then `prismabib credentials test scopus` (one request; it needs no project). Only `credentials test scopus --project <slug>` and `prismabib doctor --check-scopus` need a project in a Scopus mode.
To switch: `prismabib sources demo --set scopus --actor NAME` (or `--set scopus+openalex`). It is refused once any OpenAlex search run exists under raw/openalex-search/ (whatever its state) or screening decisions exist; then create a new project.

`prismabib openalex-search` cannot run until you edit these two files, in this order:

  1. <root>/demo/project.toml
     Fill in `search` under [openalex_query] -- the OpenAlex search itself (words, "quoted phrases", uppercase AND / OR / NOT). It is scaffolded empty, and an empty query is refused rather than sent.
  2. <root>/demo/criteria.yaml
     Set temporal.year_start / year_end, and whichever of doc_types.include your protocol restricts; every list left empty means no restriction on that dimension, which is a real eligibility choice rather than a placeholder. Replace the starter exclusion reason codes with the ones your review actually distinguishes, and bump `version` whenever you change any of it. The file's own comments explain each block.

Then, in order:
  prismabib openalex-search demo --budget 30 --dry-run   # cost; no request
  prismabib openalex-search demo --budget 30   # resumable
  prismabib build demo --rebuild
  prismabib flow demo
